bug.title: Draw preview size does not match committed object when zoomed in
bug.notes: Ghost and commit both use screenToWorld. Draft stores world coords; node.create stores float64 world size/points. applyNodeTransform is translate + scale(zoom,-zoom) so local +y stays up. File: src/lib/field/pointer.ts (onPointerUp/commitPen/placeBox), src/lib/field/render.ts (applyNodeTransform), src/lib/field/math.ts (screenToWorld/worldToScreen). Verify: zoom in, draw a diagonal and a box, ghost and committed geometry match in world units at that zoom.

bug.title: Shapes tool still draws at the wrong scale for a very small square
bug.notes: Removed the 8-world-unit floor on committed width/height. Click-vs-drag threshold is 3 CSS pixels converted to world (px/zoom), not a world-unit min size. Tiny drags store the actual float64 world size. File: src/lib/field/pointer.ts (minWorldFromPixels, placeBox). Verify: zoom to 8x, drag a ~16px square; committed size must be 2 world units (not 8). Recheck at default zoom.
